description: This file defines a class `FormatWithGender` which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. It provides a method to format an employee entity's gender value by mapping it through a constant array `Employee::GENDER`. The class is part of the `OrangeHRM` human resource management system, specifically within the maintenance access strategy for formatting values.

classes.name: FormatWithGender
classes.description: A class that implements `ValueFormatter` to format gender values based on the `Employee::GENDER` mapping.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the gender description corresponding to the input value using the `Employee::GENDER` array, or null if not found.
